12 days Rajasthan heritage and wildlife tour

Delhi · Agra · Ranthambore · Jaipur · Jodhpur · Udaipur · 12 days

12 days Rajasthan tour packages Private tour Licensed guide

Twelve days across Rajasthan with two tiger safaris in Ranthambore, three fort cities and the lakes at Udaipur.

Destinations

Transport

What makes this one worth it

  • Morning and afternoon tiger safaris in Ranthambore National Park
  • Two full days in Jaipur rather than one
  • Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada and Umaid Bhawan Palace
  • Ranakpur Jain Temple between Jodhpur and Udaipur
  • Boat ride on Lake Pichola at the end of the route

Your day by day

  1. Day 1

    Arrive in Delhi

    Arrive in Delhi, private transfer to your hotel, check in and unwind.

  2. Day 2

    A full day across Delhi

    Delhi from 9 am — Jama Masjid, a rickshaw ride through Chandni Chowk, the spice market, the Red Fort from outside, then Humayun's Tomb, India Gate, Parliament House, Qutub Minar and the Lotus Temple.

  3. Day 3

    To Agra, the Baby Taj and Mehtab Bagh

    Checkout around 10 am, three hours to Agra. Itimad-ud-Daulah, then sunset over the Taj from Mehtab Bagh.

  4. Day 4

    Sunrise Taj Mahal, then on to Ranthambore

    Taj Mahal at sunrise, breakfast and checkout, Agra Fort, then the drive to Ranthambore.

  5. Day 5

    Two tiger safaris in Ranthambore

    Morning safari in Ranthambore National Park, breakfast and rest at the resort, then a second safari in the afternoon.

  6. Day 6

    To Jaipur — City Palace and Jantar Mantar

    Drive to Jaipur, about four hours. City Palace and Jantar Mantar on arrival, with a photo stop at Hawa Mahal.

  7. Day 7

    Amber Fort and the Albert Hall Museum

    Amber Fort, a photo stop at Jal Mahal, the Monkey Temple and the Albert Hall Museum.

  8. Day 8

    The drive to Jodhpur

    Six hours to Jodhpur. Check in and take the rest of the day at your own pace.

  9. Day 9

    Mehrangarh Fort and the Blue City

    Mehrangarh Fort, Jaswant Thada, Umaid Bhawan Palace, Mandore Gardens and the Clock Tower market.

  10. Day 10

    Ranakpur Temple and on to Udaipur

    Five hours to Udaipur with a stop at the Ranakpur Jain Temple.

  11. Day 11

    Udaipur and a boat on Lake Pichola

    City Palace and Jagdish Temple, a boat ride on Lake Pichola, then Fateh Sagar Lake, Saheliyon Ki Bari and Bagore Ki Haveli.

  12. Day 12

    Departure from Udaipur

    Breakfast, checkout and transfer to Udaipur airport for your flight to Delhi or onward.

Questions people ask

How many safaris are included?
Two — one in the morning and one in the afternoon of the Ranthambore day. Zones are allotted by the Forest Department.
Is this suitable for families?
Yes. The private vehicle and the flexible schedule make it workable with children, and the safaris tend to be the highlight for them.
Can the route be shortened?
Yes. Dropping Ranthambore gives you the 10 day version; dropping Jodhpur gives eight.
